note: BlueKai, data management platform, Seattle; acquired by Oracle in 2014 for a reported ~$350M. Entry stage disputed to Growth on Battery's own case study ('Battery led the Series B funding round in BlueKai in 2008'), against the deterministic Pre-Seed band.

Bluestem Brands, Eden Prairie MN direct-to-consumer retail (Fingerhut, Gettington); sold to Capmark in 2014, Chapter 11 in 2020 with the brands sold on. DISPUTE of the Pre-Seed band: the Michael Brown Form Ds are small 2011-2013 filings into a large multi-brand retailer, not a seed round.

Callidus Software (NASDAQ: CALD), sales performance management; IPO 2003, acquired by SAP in 2018 for $2.4B. DISPUTE of the Seed band and its graduation=false: the company was already NASDAQ-listed when the 2010 Form D naming William Binch was filed, so a Seed entry is impossible and a public company cannot end graduation false (invariant 7). Battery's position is a pre-IPO round, pre-window.

Cedar Point Communications, Derry NH cable-voice switching; acquired by Genband in 2010. Thomas Crotty on the 2009 Form D inside his 1990-2013 tenure. DISPUTE of the Seed band: the 2009 $3.4M filing is a late bridge into a company founded in 2000 and already shipping carrier switches.

Consona Corp., Indianapolis ERP and CRM roll-up (Made2Manage lineage); merged with CDC Software into Aptean in 2012. DISPUTE of the Seed band: this is the lineage Battery's own Forterro case study calls 'the firm's first-ever buyout transaction in 2003', so a 2010 $6.7M add-on financing is not a seed round.

CrediFi Corp., commercial-real-estate credit data; acquired by Actovia in 2020. DISPUTE of the Pre-Seed band, which rode a $100 placeholder filing in 2014q1; the first real round is the 2014 $2.0M, a seed by the era-2011-14 ceiling.

Glassdoor, employer reviews and jobs; acquired by Recruit Holdings in 2018 for $1.2B. DISPUTE of the deterministic Series A entry: Battery's own case study says 'in 2011, Battery led the company's series C funding round'. One of the eight calibration rows behind the refusal of the site's 'Early' label (R5).
